The three-dot button is a spot I recognize — I've seen those "more options" dots in other apps, so I'd probably think to look there for extra actions on a link. Clicking it gave me a clear "View details & note" option, which is exactly what I'd be after when I want to reread my note. So yes, it's reasonably discoverable.

The one thing I'd want to make sure of: when I just click the card itself — the picture or the title — I'd expect that to take me to the actual webpage, since that's the main thing I saved it for. So the three dots being the way to get into the *details* rather than the page makes sense to me, as long as those two don't get crossed. You mentioned there's another version to compare — happy to see it before I decide which feels best.
